slate-canvas.$description: Slate Canvas — Dark hero, navigation, dark showcase bands, footer, and dark heading text

charcoal-ink.$description: Charcoal Ink — Deep text, dark input text, and the cool-black foundation of surface shadows

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Light page canvas, card surfaces, board frames, and inverse text

gallery-gray.$description: Gallery Gray — Muted board canvas, pale control surfaces, dividers, and light-gray section treatment

body-slate.$description: Body Slate — Long-form body copy, secondary links, and text on white controls

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Muted text on dark surfaces, supporting labels, and fine icon strokes

silver-gray.$description: Silver Gray — Inset control outlines and low-contrast field boundaries

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Small legal copy and deeply secondary links

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Quiet icon strokes, auxiliary labels, and subtle input definition

studio-orange.$description: Studio Orange — Filled sign-up buttons and conversion moments — a concentrated warm mark against the blue-gray workspace

mid-slate.$description: Mid Slate — Dark filled account controls within the slate navigation system

tiempos.$description: Display and section headings. The high-contrast serif makes the board-heavy interface read like a creative editorial workspace rather than a conventional product dashboard.

inter.$description: Primary interface sans for navigation and buttons at 16px/700, large lead copy at 28px/400, and explanatory body copy at 24px/400.

source-sans.$description: Supporting product-board, card, link, and utility text at 16px; it keeps embedded workspace UI quieter than the marketing typography.

system-ui.$description: Compact form, provider-signup, and utility text; use 14px/600 for provider buttons.
